lootbeamslite.config.title: Loot Beams Lite Settings
lootbeamslite.config.hint.scroll: Scroll with the wheel · hover for details
lootbeamslite.config.page.beam.title: Beam and glow
lootbeamslite.config.page.beam.help: Controls the beam, the ground glow and the animated effects.
lootbeamslite.config.page.filter.title: Filter and colour
lootbeamslite.config.page.filter.help: Decides which dropped items show up, and how their colour is picked.
lootbeamslite.config.page.info.title: Names and tooltips
lootbeamslite.config.page.info.help: Sets up the world space names and the crouch tooltip.
lootbeamslite.config.page.sound.title: Sound and animation
lootbeamslite.config.page.sound.help: Adjusts the spawn sound, the fade in and the animation speed.
lootbeamslite.config.option.enableBeam.t: Draws the vertical coloured beam above dropped items. Turning it off still keeps the ground glow, the names and the tooltip.
lootbeamslite.config.option.style.tip:
Click to cycle through the beam shapes:
Classic beam: three nested shells
Thin laser: a slim, bright core
Soft haze: wider and softer
Tapered spire: narrows towards the top
Spiral ribbon: a strip winding around the axis
Double helix: two strips winding opposite ways
Floating rings: a stack of rising rings
All styles keep the close range fade and the fade towards the top, with and without a shader pack.
lootbeamslite.config.option.enableGlow.t: Draws a coloured glow under the item, using the same colour as the beam.
lootbeamslite.config.option.commonShorte: Cuts the beam of common items to about 55% of its height, so better loot stands out at a glance.
lootbeamslite.config.option.requireOnGro: Items that are still falling do not get an effect; the beam appears once they rest on a block.
lootbeamslite.config.option.enableDynami: Lets the beam and glow brightness drift over time. Turning it off gives a completely static effect and saves a little rendering work.
lootbeamslite.config.option.beamHeight.t: How far the beam reaches up from the item, in blocks. Higher values are easier to spot from far away.
lootbeamslite.config.option.beamRadius.t: Half the width of the beam. Larger values make it thicker, but too large blocks the view of nearby blocks.
lootbeamslite.config.option.beamAlpha.ti: How solid the beam looks. 0 is fully transparent, 1 is the strongest; softer styles dim this further.
lootbeamslite.config.option.glowRadius.t: Radius of the ground glow in blocks. It only affects the glow, not the vertical beam.
Moves the whole effect up or down relative to the dropped item. Positive moves up, negative moves down.
lootbeamslite.config.option.allItems.tip: Ignores the equipment and rarity conditions and shows every item that is not blacklisted. Whitelisted items always win.
lootbeamslite.config.option.onlyRare.tip: Only items whose rarity ordinal reaches the rarity threshold are shown. Combined with the equipment filter, the item has to match both.
lootbeamslite.config.option.onlyEquipmen: Restricts the effect to weapons, tools, armour, damageable items and the whitelist. Turn it off to also allow plain materials.
lootbeamslite.config.option.enableCustom: Uses the colour maps in the TOML file, by item id, tag and mod id. Item colours win over tags, tags over mods.
Items farther away than this are not drawn at all. Lowering it reduces the cost when a lot of loot is on the ground.
lootbeamslite.config.option.rareOrdinalM: Lowest rarity ordinal counted as rare: vanilla common=0, uncommon=1, rare=2, epic=3.
lootbeamslite.config.option.showName.tip: Draws the item name above the dropped item. The text uses the same colour as the beam.
lootbeamslite.config.option.nameOnLook.t: Only shows the name when the crosshair is close to the item, so names do not pile up on a busy floor.
lootbeamslite.config.option.textBorder.t: Draws a translucent dark plate behind the name, which keeps it readable in busy scenes and under shader packs.
lootbeamslite.config.option.stackCount.t: Prefixes the name with the stack size, like "32x", whenever the drop holds more than one item.
lootbeamslite.config.option.crouchToolti: While crouching and looking at a drop, shows the same full tooltip and attributes as the inventory does.
lootbeamslite.config.option.nameDistance: Only items within this many blocks show a name or the crouch tooltip.
lootbeamslite.config.option.nameScale.ti: Size of the world space names. 1 is the default; very large values can block the view.
Height of the name relative to the dropped item. Positive moves up, negative moves down.
lootbeamslite.config.option.nameBackgrou: How solid the name background is. 0 is fully transparent, 1 fully solid; requires the name background to be enabled.
Plays a local chime once when a new drop that matches the effect rules appears. Items on the sound blacklist stay silent.
Volume of the spawn chime. 0 is silent, 1 is the loudest; other game sounds are untouched.
Ticks it takes for a new beam to fade from invisible to full brightness. 20 ticks are about one second.
lootbeamslite.config.option.fadeInDistan: Range in which the beam fades away as you walk towards the item. At distance 0 it is gone; at this range it is at full brightness.
lootbeamslite.config.option.halfRoundTic: Speed of the breathing animation and of the spiral and ring styles. Smaller values move faster; 20 ticks are about one second.
